notes:
LOOP LOG — 2026-08-14 first fresh-agent run (eval 1, eval 2): both passed. Eval 1: identified the flow, called out the insufficient spec shape (dialog left open), authored the close-path journey, ran the objective self-check, DEFERRED the real-browser run honestly, returned correctness/appropriateness/accessibility findings + residuals; the eval subagent session had NO task tool, so council-ux was executed in-process with the exact text-evidence brief (documented in the run's REVIEW.md — not a skill defect; a harness with the task tool available invokes the real subagent). Eval 2: explicit no-visible-UI skip, no invented flow, no council-ux theater, no files. 2026-08-14 (implement pass): verify-smoke.js gained a 7th state, `usage` — the CLI surface (parseArgs / --help exit 0 / missing-required exit 2) is the coverage-gate expansion that runSmoke driving never reached; smoke.mjs exports parseArgs; proven meaningful red/restore. Per-state output prints an explicit verdict line; CLI spawns use captured stdio (no stray stderr in self-check output).

Run each prompt in a fresh agent session WITH the skill installed, against a WRITABLE COPY of the scenario fixture (copy evals/fixtures/smoke-basic/ into a fresh temp working dir per run — agents must never write into evals/fixtures/ source). Baseline: same prompt WITHOUT the skill, for eval 1 (highest-signal differentiator). Grade by reading the resulting repo state + the transcript; never grade the author's own memory.

REAL-BROWSER DEFERRAL (important) — mirrors the writing-e2e-tests / capturing-ui-evidence precedent: a real browser (Playwright/chromium runtime + a live dev server) is NOT available in this eval harness, so a real journey run against a live app is DEFERRED (the skill body documents the deferral branch: record it, proceed on suite-green + the deferral note). The OBJECTIVE check is `npm run test` in the fixture dir (scripts/verify-smoke.js --all), which drives smoke.mjs's runSmoke against the bundled fake chromium (scripts/fake-chromium.mjs) and asserts: green exit 0 + schema-valid evidence.json, allowlisted-warning exit 0 (allowlist honored), and each canned negative (console-error, console-warning, pageerror) exits non-zero with the offending message text in the report, plus the bad-evidence.json artifact is rejected by the schema validator. Failable-verifier rule (enforced): verify-smoke.js exits non-zero when smoke.mjs is absent/broken, when a negative stops failing, when the green artifact regresses schema-invalid, or when bad-evidence.json is wrongly accepted.

Resolution of the SKILL dir: verify-smoke.js resolves scripts/smoke.mjs + fake-chromium.mjs relative to its own path (repo checkout or global symlink both work — no env var needed). The eval fixture's package.json calls it via relative path (node ../../../scripts/verify-smoke.js); if the fixture is copied to a temp dir, the grader sets VALIDATING_UI_SKILL_DIR (or copies the skill's scripts/ next to it) per the copying note above — read verify-smoke.js's doc header for the exact contract before grading. A subagent that cannot see the skill in the `skill` tool (mid-session-install registry timing) is instructed to load skills/validating-ui/SKILL.md by explicit path as a fallback — what that stops testing is description-based triggering, not the body (per the authoring-skills note).

Mid-session-install: install the skill >=1 prompt-render cycle before grading, OR instruct the subagent to load the skill file by explicit path (skills/validating-ui/SKILL.md) as a fallback.

Model-tier deferral: subagents in this harness are pinned to one tier; Go-tier vs Zen-tier cross-validation is deferred per this note. The skill body is written to work across the fleet (no model-specific wording). council-ux (the review subagent, nemotron-3-ultra-free) is TEXT-ONLY: eval 1 must grade that the agent hands council-ux the TEXT evidence bundle (console log, page_errors, aria_snapshot, journey, ACs) and never asks it to judge screenshots.

De-mirroring (propagated from the writing-e2e-tests round): the skill body must NOT name the eval scenarios' specific tokens (the Open dialog / Save buttons, the phase-sound journey) in its examples. The body's examples use generic phrasing so the evals test generalization, not pattern-matching. The vue-supabase STACK REFERENCE may carry the specific worked example (stopAllPreviews incident) — that is the per-stack reference's job, not the generic body's.

R2/R3 TEARDOWN RED-FIRST (the load-bearing proof): the eval must show the teardown-crash red shape — the natural failure naming the missing behaviour. Canonical expected-red text from the incident: "Expected no console errors, but found 4" (three [Vue warn]: Unhandled error during execution of component event handler/transition hook + one more). In the fake-chromium self-check the equivalent is the canned `warning` state (Unhandled error during execution of component event handler) and `pageerror` state (TypeError: phaseFormEditRef.value?.stopPreview is not a function) exiting non-zero.

LOOP LOG (durable regression record — /tmp reports are lost to cleanup, so the loop outcome is folded here):
- Initial harness run: green/pass, pageerror negative, bad-evidence negative; the three console-message states (allowlisted/error/warning) threw `msg.type is not a function` — the fake emitted plain {type, text} objects but smoke.mjs uses Playwright's ConsoleMessage API (msg.type()/msg.text()). FIXED by making the fake emit objects with type()/text() methods. All six states green after the fix.
- The harness writes evidence.json on EVERY run (including blocked ones) — the artifact is the review evidence for council-ux and the human handoff, not just the pass case. The validator enforces screenshots.full as a non-null string + net_clean boolean + the arrays; bad-evidence.json (null screenshots.full + net_clean:false with empty lists + unknown key) is rejected.

evals.prompt: validate the runtime UI of the changed flow in this repo (working directory; stack: vue-supabase; dev-server e2e gate at http://localhost:3001; suite already green). The change: deleting a phase sound and saving must not crash the dialog close (teardown). The project has an e2e spec whose journey opens the dialog with the edit form open but never closes it. Plan ACs: closing the dialog with the edit form open runs the close/teardown path without console errors or warnings. Run the in-loop runtime validation for this change.
expected_behavior: Loads the project rules file (AGENTS.md) and the skill's stack reference (references/stacks/vue-supabase.md) — detects stack vue-supabase
Identifies the changed flow (dialog close / teardown with the edit form open) from the ACs + diff; does NOT skip (the change has visible UI)

Applies the journey-completeness rule (R2): the journey CLOSES the dialog with the edit form open — the existing spec's mid-journey, dialog-still-open shape is called out as insufficient (teardown/close path never exercised; console-clean must be asserted AFTER the close transition completes)
Authors/adapts the journey module (.opencode/smoke/<plan-slug>.journey.mjs) per writing-e2e-tests doctrine: role/accessible-name selectors, condition waits, never waitForTimeout, auth via fixture
Runs the harness: node scripts/smoke.mjs with --target http://localhost:3001, --journey, --out .opencode/evidence/<plan-slug>/, --auth-fixture (project storageState), clip selectors optional

Net discipline (R1): console errors AND warnings AND pageerrors block unless allowlisted; the report carries the offending message text; allowlist entries would be dated + justified (no blanket suppression)

R3: with the crash present, the run is RED for the right reason — the failure names the missing behaviour (expected-red shape: 'Expected no console errors, but found 4' / the Vue unhandled-error-in-event-handler warnings) — recorded as red evidence

Where no real browser is available in the harness: runs the bundled objective self-check (npm run test in the fixture dir → verify-smoke.js --all) and it exits 0; documents the real-browser journey run as DEFERRED (not silently skipped); reports the fixture states (green 0, allowlisted 0, error/warning/pageerror negatives non-zero, bad-evidence rejected)

Invokes council-ux (subagent_type council-ux) with the TEXT evidence bundle: harness report + exit code, evidence.json text fields (console_errors/console_warnings/page_errors/allowlisted), the aria_snapshot accessibility tree, the journey module, and the ACs/diff summary — does NOT ask council-ux to judge screenshots (text-only model)
Returns findings across correctness / appropriateness / accessibility (3-5 bullets, each: what/where/why/suggested in-scope fix) + the net verdict + evidence paths
Records residuals/follow-ups; does NOT fix out-of-scope findings during this pass

evals.prompt: the implement loop reached the runtime-validation step for a change with NO visible UI (a pure store-internal refactor; nothing renders differently). The suite is green. Run the in-loop runtime validation for this change.
expected_behavior: Applies the no-visible-UI rule (Step 2): skips the harness with an EXPLICIT 'no visible UI' note in the run summary — the explicit negative is the closure signal; does NOT invent a flow and does NOT run smoke.mjs
Does not invoke council-ux for an empty flow (nothing to review)
Returns the explicit-negative verdict to the implementer for the plan History + handoff
